scope: Author controls are separate from physical gate dispositions.

controls.name: Pair-source Fourier normalization agrees with the analytic Gaussian
Independent invariant phase-space quadrature converges and agrees with the review Born estimate
Full high-field radial stationary point is stable in amplitude and respects the analytic lower bound
Independent angular finite differences match the physical phase mass matrix and its gauge null mode
Full complex release conserves gauge charge and scalar stress, with zero aligned source and conjugate preparations
Screened binding bound agrees with Parseval and positive massive-vector energy
Proposed bias has the stated stationary vacua and a positive global factorization
Residual gauge quantum numbers distinguish one core from a neutral three-core group

six_physical_tests.qualification: The full quartics stabilize the high-field branch; its truncated single-field AD description fails.
Own-potential alignment gives zero charge. The review assumes an additional phase mismatch; a full inflationary fluctuation calculation is absent.
A separately proposed DeltaV=1e-22 GeV^4 variant passes a scaling-time estimate, not a network simulation.
Fixed abundance leaves a small extra-pair budget; no number-changing or full transition/debris evolution is computed.
Screened classical binding survives with an enormous margin. Full fluctuation/metastability and a quantum population state remain open.
Coherent plus free-Born pairs is still far below the engineering target; complete in-medium quantum loss is uncomputed.
